scope: Read-only rights review of existing Exhibit of Sorrows and Burger & Frights candidates. No public assets or shared game data modified.
inventoryCaveat: media-preview-index.json has stale error entries for both titles. Local cover existence and author-page og:image were independently checked. No local author-page gameplay screenshot candidates exist for these two games. Video capture files are research evidence, not automatically cleared public screenshots.

sources.observed: The author game page explicitly declares asset license Creative Commons Attribution v4.0 International; code license Unlicense is distinct. A downloadable youtubeAssetsKit.zip is listed, but archive contents and any specific enclosed notices were not inspected.
The author development article identifies Theresa Kao as the game artist.
Author-uploaded cover confirmed in og:image. Page says full credits are in game. No per-image license notice or press kit observed.

An author-account reply to a gameplay-video question says game components are under CC0 or CC BY and attribution is in the game credits. This does not identify the version or creator of every component, nor explicitly classify the promotional cover.
Author profile reviewed; no game-specific press-image reuse permission identified.

Section 3(a) permits a URI or hyperlink for license and material identification and reasonable attribution based on medium and context; supplied credit/copyright/license/disclaimer notices and modification indications must be retained.
